name: locations
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: browser gym game environment sprite atlas.
Create ONE square image divided into an EXACT 2x2 grid of four equal square atmospheric environment photos. Absolutely zero gutters, gaps, borders, separator lines or text. Each quadrant fills its area edge-to-edge. FOUR DIFFERENT EMPTY gyms, no people anywhere.
TOP LEFT: a rusty underground basement iron gym, old iron squat racks, barbells and plates, scarred concrete floor, moody warm amber and cyan lighting, gritty working-class atmosphere.
TOP RIGHT: an outdoor brutalist calisthenics courtyard at sunset, weathered concrete buildings, outdoor black iron pullup bars and parallel bars, weightlifting area, warm sunset sky and long shadows, clearly outdoors.
BOTTOM LEFT: a luxurious weightlifting gym styled as a majestic ancient Greek temple, tall white marble columns, marble floors, heavy weight racks and barbells, dramatically violet and lavender lighting, grand high ceiling.
BOTTOM RIGHT: a championship wrestling gym and grand black-and-gold arena, wrestling ring, training area with weights, monumental gold lights and dark grandstands, unmistakable tournament atmosphere.
Style: cinematic photorealism, realistic materials, detailed environments, dramatic light. Each quadrant depicts a different complete scene with centered usable space and clear equipment. Make atmospheric differences immediately obvious at thumbnail size.
Constraints: strict equal 2x2 grid, no text, logos, watermarks, UI, labels, lettering, frames, or people.

name: workout
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: browser gym game workout animation sprite atlas.
Create ONE square contact sheet split into an EXACT 2x2 grid of four equal-sized square PHOTOGRAPHS with NO GUTTERS, NO GAPS, NO BORDERS, NO DIVIDER LINES and NO TEXT. Each photo fills its quadrant edge-to-edge.
All four show the SAME adult male bodybuilder aged 30: short dark brown hair, dark beard stubble, serious focused expression, hypermuscular but anatomically plausible sports physique, bare upper torso, charcoal knee-length training shorts, black athletic shoes. Photoreal sports context without eroticism. Same dark industrial gym with consistent dramatic cyan rim light and warm amber key light. Entire exercise including hands and barbell must be visible in each quadrant. Loaded black iron barbell.
TOP LEFT: bench press START / bottom position, lying flat on a bench with feet planted on the ground, both hands grip the bar symmetrically, elbows bent, barbell just above lower chest. Side three-quarter view showing full bench, whole body, bar and weight plates.
TOP RIGHT: bench press FINISH / top position, precisely the same bench, camera, equipment and athlete location as top left; lying flat on bench, feet planted, both arms extended up nearly straight with barbell above upper chest. The same crop and same scale as top left for matching animation.
BOTTOM LEFT: deadlift START position, standing bent at hips and knees with neutral back, both hands gripping a loaded barbell on the floor over his midfoot, hips above knees, chest up. Side three-quarter view shows entire body, barbell and plates.
BOTTOM RIGHT: deadlift FINISH position, precisely same camera and equipment as bottom left, athlete standing upright with hips and knees extended, arms straight down, both hands holding loaded barbell against upper thighs. Same crop and same scale as bottom left for matching animation.
Composition: four complete clearly legible action photographs in exact equal 2x2 grid; center subject in each square, realistic exercise mechanics, matching identities and equipment. The two bench press poses and the two deadlift poses must visibly differ in bar height.
Constraints: no text, logos, lettering, watermark, cards, UI, graphic overlay or extra people. Sports photography only.
